## Highlights

- Subscription-backed fleet turns now start successfully when the organization reserves the request at no cost. The reservation reader accepts the zero-cost result only on the explicit subscription lane, while paid gateway turns continue to require a positive budget. [#4793](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4793)

## Upgrade notes

- No operator action or data migration is required. Deploy the platform image and its matching managed-deployment CLI together so the fleet manager and workers use the same reservation contract.
